params.label: Segmentation
params.tip: Select which label set to skeletonise

params.label: Output name
params.tip: Name for the output branch label set

params.label: Restrict to population
params.tip: Skeletonise only these cells; NONE = the whole segmentation

params.label: Pre-dilation
params.tip: Close gaps by this many pixels before skeletonising (0 = off)

params.label: Post-dilation
params.tip: Thicken the saved skeleton for visibility; measures are unaffected

params.label: Use label boundaries
params.tip: Skeletonise the label outlines instead of their interiors

params.label: Flatten Z
params.tip: Project the stack to one plane and skeletonise in 2D (3D only)

params.label: Anisotropy
params.tip: Measure local fibre alignment per branch; needs fibre channels

params.label: Anisotropy on Z-MIP
params.tip: Measure alignment on the Z projection instead of the full stack

params.label: Fibre channels
params.tip: Channels carrying the fibre signal alignment is measured on

params.label: Structure-tensor sigma (px)
params.tip: Smoothing before alignment; raise it for thicker or noisier fibres

params.label: Anisotropy box size (px)
params.tip: Neighbourhood each branch's alignment is averaged over
